title: Mister Car Wash Doesn't Really Sell Car Washes
summary: At Mister Car Wash, 79% of wash sales in late 2025 came from 2.3 million monthly members. Here's how the unlimited wash club works, why private equity rushed to build express tunnels, and why one chain still went bankrupt.

hooks.hook: At Mister Car Wash, 79% of wash sales came from people paying a monthly fee.
Your car wash isn't selling clean cars. It's selling a monthly payment.
America built about 900 car washes in one year. Then a big chain went bankrupt.
Mister Car Wash's own annual report says a member spends more than four times a regular customer.
Why is there a new car wash on every corner?

sources: Mister Car Wash FY2025 results (8-K Ex. 99.1, Feb 18, 2026): net revenues $1,051.7M; adjusted EBITDA $345.4M; net income $103.1M; "Ended the quarter with approximately 2.3 million UWC members"; "UWC sales represented 79% of total wash sales" in Q4 2025: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853513/000119312526056047/d113732dex991.htm

Mister Car Wash 2025 Form 10-K: 548 locations in 21 states at Dec 31, 2025; "In 2025, we increased overall UWC penetration from 74% to 76% of total wash sales"; "UWC Members contribute a significant portion of our net revenue and provide recurring revenue through their monthly membership fees"; a UWC member "spends more than four times the retail car wash consumer" (Item 1): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1853513/000119312526078965/mcw-20251231.htm
Mister Car Wash membership terms: "YOUR UWC MEMBERSHIP PLAN WILL AUTOMATICALLY RENEW MONTHLY": https://mistercarwash.com/member-terms

"Over the last decade, more car washes were built than all the preceding years combined"; "Fueled by private equity and a subscription-based business model" (Bloomberg CityLab, Feb 21, 2024): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2024-02-21/citylab-daily-a-car-wash-mania-is-taking-over-the-us

Industry estimate (equipment maker Sonny's, via Professional Carwashing & Detailing, 2025 State of the Carwash Market): "around 850-900 new stores in 2023", now about 550 a year (plus or minus 100), over 90% express tunnels: https://www.carwash.com/2025-state-of-the-carwash-market/

Express tunnel construction "$5 to $8 million", land often more than $1 million (Star Tribune, Jan 2025): https://www.startribune.com/car-wash-subscription-private-equity-boom-everywhere-drive-thru-tunnel/601209808

Driven Brands agrees to divest its U.S. car wash business to Whistle Express for $385 million (Feb 25, 2025); closed Apr 10, 2025: https://investors.drivenbrands.com/news-and-events/news/news-details/2025/Driven-Brands-Announces-Agreement-to-Divest-U.S.-Car-Wash-Business-for-385-Million/default.aspx

Whistle Express (majority investment from funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management since 2023) on the Driven deal (Business Wire, Feb 25, 2025): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250225313854/en

Mister Car Wash to be taken private by Leonard Green & Partners at $7.00 a share, total enterprise value $3.1 billion (Feb 18, 2026); completed May 2026: https://mistercarwash.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/mister-car-wash-be-taken-private-leonard-green-partners-700 and https://www.lw.com/en/news/2026/05/latham-watkins-advises-mister-car-wash-in-completed-take-private-acquisition
Zips Car Wash files Chapter 11, "operating approximately 260 locations across 23 states" (Business Wire, Feb 5, 2025): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250205641535/en
Our math: adjusted EBITDA $345.4M / revenue $1,051.7M = 32.8%, about 33 cents per dollar.

scenes.narration: At Mister Car Wash, one of America's biggest chains, {79 percent|seventy-nine percent} of wash sales at the end of last year came from people paying a monthly fee.
That idea, the unlimited wash club, helped set off a building boom. In the decade before {2024,|twenty twenty-four,} America built more car washes than in all the years before it combined.
But in {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} one big chain, Zips, filed for bankruptcy. If memberships are such a great business, how does that happen? Hold that thought.
Let's follow the money: how the club works, why investors rushed in, and where it broke.
Part one. The club.
At the end of {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} Mister Car Wash had about {2.3 million|two point three million} members in its Unlimited Wash Club, across {548|five hundred forty-eight} locations.

data.label: Unlimited Wash Club members, end of 2025

scenes.narration: Over the full year, members made up {76 percent|seventy-six percent} of all its wash sales, up from {74|seventy-four} the year before.
Its annual report says members provide recurring revenue through their monthly membership fees.

data.quote: UWC Members contribute a significant portion of our net revenue and provide *recurring revenue* through their monthly membership fees.

scenes.narration: And members spend more. Mister says a member spends more than four times what a regular pay-per-wash customer does.
Why does that matter? A rainy month empties a pay-per-wash lot. A membership renews on schedule, every month, rain or shine.

It shows in the numbers. On just over a billion dollars of revenue in {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} Mister made {$345 million|three hundred forty-five million} in what Wall Street calls adjusted EBITDA. That's about {33 cents|thirty-three cents} of every dollar, before interest, taxes and wear on its machines.

data.label: adjusted EBITDA, 2025 (about 33% of revenue)
data.source: Mister Car Wash 2025 results; % = our math

scenes.narration: If you like seeing the receipts behind everyday prices, subscribe. New ones every Tuesday and Friday.
Part two. The rush.
Steady monthly money is exactly what investors love. And they piled in.
In {2023|twenty twenty-three} alone, roughly {900|nine hundred} new car washes went up in the US, by one equipment maker's industry estimate.

data.label: new car washes, 2023 (estimate: 850 to 900)
data.source: Sonny's estimate, via Professional Carwashing & Detailing

scenes.narration: Each new express tunnel can cost {5 to 8 million dollars|five to eight million dollars} to build, before you even buy the land.
In {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} Driven Brands sold its US car wash chain to Whistle Express, backed by the investment firm Oaktree, for {$385 million.|three hundred eighty-five million dollars.}
Then in {2026,|twenty twenty-six,} the private equity firm Leonard Green took Mister Car Wash private, at a value of {$3.1 billion,|three point one billion dollars,} debt included.
Part three. Where it broke.
Back to Zips. In February {2025,|twenty twenty-five,} with about {260|two hundred sixty} locations in {23|twenty-three} states, it filed for {Chapter 11|chapter eleven} bankruptcy protection.
It had borrowed heavily. Bloomberg reported a {$654 million|six hundred fifty-four million dollar} loan behind the chain.
A tunnel only pays off if enough cars roll through it. Build too many too close together, and they split the same drivers.
And the boom is cooling. By the same industry estimate, new builds have dropped to roughly {550|five hundred fifty} a year.

data.label: new car washes a year, 2025 (estimate)
data.source: Sonny's estimate, via Professional Carwashing & Detailing

scenes.narration: So how does a subscription business go bankrupt? Memberships bring in steady money every month. But steady money can't carry unlimited debt, or too many tunnels chasing the same cars.
Your car wash isn't really selling clean cars. It's selling a monthly payment. Next time: why cinemas once banned popcorn.
